senses.gloss:
mfn. (-फः-फा-फं)
1 Low, vile, contemptible, wicked.
2 Defamed, reviled.
m. (-फः)
1 The letter र्.
2 Passion, affection of the mind.
E.
र the letter R with the inherent short vowel, and इफ aff.; or रिफ् to defame, to reproach, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-फाः-फाः-फः)
1 Low, vile, contemptible.
2 Wicked, abandoned.
3 Miserly, a niggard.
4 Cruel, savage.
E.
रिफ् to reproach, aff. असुन्; also रेफ, रेपस्, and रेप.
